name: mcp2221
description: Claude Code plugins for the MCP2221 USB-to-I2C adapter and its LED matrix.

plugins.name: led-matrix
plugins.description: Plays a working animation on an MCP2221 + HT16K33 LED matrix while Claude works, and blanks it when Claude is done.

plugins.name: progress-pie
plugins.description: Shows a pie of a multi-part job's progress in the status line and on the MCP2221 + HT16K33 LED matrix, including while background work runs.
